sandbox: fresh 390×844 browser context; use the landing action; assert a sample card with Level and Room noise is in the first viewport

fresh browser context; open /demo; assert Desk distance is noticeable, One hand closer is low, and the conclusion names Take 2 as having less room noise

sandbox: fresh browser context; record all requests during demo; assert every request is same-origin and every request is GET or HEAD
fresh browser context; demo; click Export WAV; assert a .wav download begins

claim: Use it after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit /demo, wait for service worker control, reload online once, set offline, reload; assert two sample takes

claim: Try the sample without an account or payment
sandbox: fresh browser context; use the landing action; assert the two-take demo opens with no account or payment field

claim: Your microphone is only requested when you record
sandbox: fresh browser context; instrument getUserMedia; assert zero calls on load and exactly one after Record

claim: A take is up to 15 seconds
sandbox: fresh fake-microphone context; start a take; assert it automatically finishes with a displayed length of 15.0s

claim: Recordings stay in this browser until you delete them
sandbox: fresh fake-microphone context; record, reload, and delete; assert it survives reload and disappears after deletion

claim: Demo and real takes use separate storage namespaces
sandbox: fresh fake-microphone context; seed demo, open real mode directly, record; assert IndexedDB contains independent demo:takes and real:takes keys

claim: The chosen quieter take stays marked after reload
sandbox: fresh demo; choose the quieter take, reload; assert the same take remains visibly and accessibly marked Preferred

claim: Demo changes are discarded when you discard the demo and record
sandbox: fresh demo; delete a sample, choose Discard demo and record; assert demo:takes is removed, real mode is empty, and returning to demo restores both samples
